summary: Manage a distributed organization of 12+ engineers and around four technical leads, owning delivery, engineering leadership and technical standards.
requirements: Experience managing engineering leads/managers and delivery across multiple teams, software engineering judgment, product/CTO partnership and clear stakeholder communication. Fluent English and Spanish required. Next.js/Ruby on Rails, commerce/payments and distributed hiring experience preferred.
conditions: Employer explicitly allows candidates anywhere in the world. Full-time remote work aligned to New York/EST time. Listed benefits include 20 PTO days, 13 paid holidays, sick days and equity participation. Visa sponsorship not disclosed.
